title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཞེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 190)
shelf_note: Belongs to the Pramāṇa (tsad ma / logic and epistemology) section of the Derge Tengyur (volume zhe, vol. 190), containing Indian Buddhist epistemological debate texts engaging Sāṃkhya and Nyāya positions.

tr_errors_A.english: the fault in the proof established by the Sāṃkhya
tr_errors_A.problem: Translates the technical logical fault siddhasādhana-doṣa (the fallacy of proving what is already established) loosely as 'the fault in the proof established by the Sāṃkhya'.

tr_errors_B.english: clarity / clearly manifest / phenomenon contrary to clarity
tr_errors_B.problem: Systematically mistranslates the foundational Sāṃkhya technical term གསལ་བ་ (vyakta, 'the manifest' / manifest phenomena, contrasted with avyakta / prakṛti) as 'clarity', distorting the debate regarding whether manifest phenomena share an identical nature with primordial matter.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A correctly translates the core Sāṃkhya technical category གསལ་བ་ as 'the manifest' (vyakta), whereas Translation B renders it throughout as 'clarity', distorting the philosophical argument.

book_verdict: The folio is an authentic Derge Tengyur woodblock print from the Pramāṇa section transcribed with perfect OCR accuracy. Translation A is distinctly preferable as Translation B fundamentally misinterprets the technical ontological category vyakta ('the manifest') as 'clarity'.
